as_told.title: Condon Committee and the Hippler letters

plain: Letters from the 1960s are said to show that the physicist Edward Condon, who led an Air Force-funded study of UFOs, was working closely with an Air Force colonel named Robert Hippler, and that Hippler wanted the study to find UFO research "a waste of money." Michels tells this himself across several episodes, without naming where he read the letters, and he is not always equally sure: once he says only "I believe there are letters too," and elsewhere he adds that Condon "kind of implicitly" went along. If true, it would mean the study's verdict against UFOs was steered before it began.
